svg.text: Block processing per unit of work, state by state
median newPayload ms per MGas, full blocks (≥ 50 Mgas) · right: ms per block, two trees under the load → binary only
'one tree' = the hexary trie alone (erigon's week before 10-25; the first hour of the others). 'binary only' = after the fork on the fixed builds: from
10-30 09:55 for geth-1/3 and 11:48 for geth-2, from one hour after the fork for the others. Full blocks were ~97 Mgas before the load and ~193 under it, so
per MGas falls as per block rises.
